yral is a multidisciplinary team of five members from Cochabamba, Bolivia, focused on innovation and technological development. We participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge, developing solutions that combine artificial intelligence, data analysis, and satellite technology to address environmental challenges, natural phenomena, and risk prevention. Our goal is to transform data into impactful solutions for society.
details:
BYRAL SENTINEL is a comprehensive territorial intelligence system designed to improve the prevention and understanding of natural risks in Cochabamba, Bolivia.

It integrates NASA satellite data, municipal historical records, environmental variables, and artificial intelligence to analyze risk scenarios, visualize potentially vulnerable areas, and provide information tailored to each user’s specific location and needs.

As part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we developed an experimental MVP that demonstrates the platform’s core functionality through interactive maps, AI-driven queries, and risk simulations.

Our goal is to transform scientific data into clear, accessible, and useful information to help build better-prepared and more resilient communities.
